name: Hostinger managed Node.js hosting

evidence.paas: 03: hosted managed app service; Hostinger runs the Node.js runtime and server stack
evidence.static: 04: frontend projects can publish static output without a Node process

line: Deploy Node.js applications on managed web and cloud plans.

free.text: No ongoing free managed Node.js allowance

cells.regions: Europe, India, Southeast Asia, USA and Brazil

work.math: The 48-month offer is $2.79 a month equivalent. The normal one-month price and setup fee are unknown.
The plan has 2 cores and 3 GB. The one-month rate is not published, and billing for 730 hours is not stated.
An outside PostgreSQL database is required. The full price and a regular monthly quote are unknown.
